events.title: Oasis's Debut Album 'Definitely Maybe' Turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their groundbreaking debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Debut Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 32 years since Oasis dropped their debut and changed the game. Still sounds as fresh today.

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair kicked off on this day in 1969, bringing "3 Days of Peace & Music" to half a million people.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million people gathered for three days of peace, love, and music at Woodstock. What an era.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The world remembers 'The King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: 49 years since the music world lost The King. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur passed away on September 13, 1996, six days after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: 30 years since we lost a hip-hop pioneer. Tupac Shakur's influence remains undeniable.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: 56 years since the world lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. Still redefining what's possible on guitar.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic zebra crossing photo is still one of the most famous album covers ever.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th to Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and proving that rock'n'roll never forgets.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still a rock'n'roll star.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. A message of peace that still resonates globally.

events.title: The First iPod Launched 25 Years Ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember loading all your CDs onto this? The original iPod turns 25 this month, forever changing how we listen to music.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day Angle
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Shaken, not stirred, and still saving the world after all these years.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. Still a musical icon, still inspiring peace.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! No silly walks required, just pure comedic genius.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped their iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that proved their incredible range.
